title: upstream: OpenMLS GREASE KeyPackage extension rejected
description: OpenMLS 0.9.1 (still on main be2368a): Extension::Unknown(kind,_) maps to ExtensionType::Unknown while the same GREASE value in capabilities decodes as ExtensionType::Grease; contains_extensions compares them in a HashSet, so key_package_in.rs:191 rejects a valid KeyPackage carrying a GREASE extension (RFC 9420 §13.5) with UnsupportedExtension. Fixed on our fork MarkAtwood/openmls mimid-0.9.1 (5abd9e0) with regression test key_package_validation_with_grease_extension. Report upstream (issue + PR) only with Mark's explicit per-action OK.
